slots.notes: Inter (weights 300-700) loaded globally via Google Fonts; the single typeface for everything in the section - eyebrow pill, the 'A fully modern curriculum.' heading, module titles/subtitles, and lesson rows. Acts as both display and body since no second face is declared.

Material Symbols Outlined icon font (variable axes FILL/wght/GRAD/opsz) loaded globally; supplies the two glyphs the accordion uses - 'expand_more' chevron in the 36px circular toggle (rotates 180 on open) and 'check' in the 20px lesson bullet. Tinted via currentColor (foreground / foreground/80), not swappable image assets.

mechanic: A single-open-at-a-time accordion of module rows inside a #161616 card whose 1px border carries a cursor-tracked radial white spotlight, each row's body collapsing via a framer-motion height+opacity transition (300ms easeInOut) with a 180-degree chevron rotation, and pill/heading/rows fading up on scroll with a 0.15s per-row stagger.
techDelivery: React 18 + Vite + TypeScript + TailwindCSS (HSL semantic tokens) + framer-motion, with a clsx/tailwind-merge cn() helper; authored as a multi-file drop-in component spec (CurriculumSection + ModuleAccordion plus MIcon/FadeUp/SpotlightBorder primitives), not a single-file CDN bundle.
reskinNotes: The card background #161616 is hardcoded as an inline style (style={{ backgroundColor }}) rather than a token, so it ignores a palette swap. Colors come from three different sources that must all be edited to reskin: Tailwind HSL CSS variables (bg-background / text-foreground in index.css), raw white/N utility opacities baked across the markup (white/10 borders, white/[0.04] and white/[0.06] fills, foreground/50-85 text), and the inline hex. A second surface tone, the pill background rgba(255,255,255,0.10) (Tailwind token landing.surface, recorded as surface2), is distinct from the card surface. The spotlight glow is a hardcoded white rgba inside the radial-gradient string in SpotlightBorder, so accent re-tinting needs a code edit. The design is monochrome (no accent color declared). All course copy - eyebrow 'Course Curriculum', heading 'A fully modern curriculum.', and the four modules with their titles, subtitles, and lesson arrays - is hardcoded in a modules array in the component, and the icons are Material Symbols glyph names ('expand_more','check') rather than swappable assets.
